channel.description: Latest articles from Salt Lake Tribune (sltrib.com)

item.title: St. George is on the cusp of being a two-Costco town
item.description: Even as workers rush to apply the finishing touches on the new Costco store located just off Interstate-15 at 4700 S. Desert Color Parkway, a steady stream of vehicles are already gassing up at the five-lane fuel center that features 40 fueling positions. City officials say the fuel center is a sign of great things to come for Costco South St. George’s formal debut, which is slated for March 13.

item.title: USA Climbing has ambitious Olympic goal for new headquarters in SLC — but what happens to a relic next door?
item.description: USA Climbing wants to open its new Salt Lake City digs before the Olympics return to the U.S. in 2028, but there's still a big-dollar question about what happens to a 119-year-old building next door

item.title: NAACP president looks forward to seeing what’s next for his group’s alliance with the LDS Church
item.description: NAACP President and CEO Derrick Johnson is eager to speak with new LDS Church President Dallin Oaks about the next steps in their partnership.

item.title: A small nuclear reactor just landed in Utah. Here’s what it means for the state
item.description: A small nuclear test reactor arrived in Utah aboard U.S. military aircraft. It won’t power homes, but state and federal leaders say it signals a new chapter for Utah’s energy future. Here’s what to know.

item.title: Utah daughter, mom reportedly found dead in Las Vegas hotel room
item.description: Police have not confirmed the deaths, but Utah Xtreme Cheer said the mother and daughter were from Utah and in Las Vegas for a competition.

item.title: ‘Finally starting to see winter’: A colder, wetter, windier week is on tap for Utah. Here’s what to expect.
item.description: Utah ski resorts could see a big week of snow with a pair of storms expected to roll in.

item.title: Prop 4: When Utahns will know if GOP’s signature-gathering effort was a success
item.description: County clerks have 21 days to verify the signatures Utahns for Representative Government submitted in boxes on Sunday.

item.title: ‘We have met the threshold’: GOP says they have enough signatures to send Prop 4 repeal to Utah voters
item.description: “We are well over 200,000 signatures that have been submitted. We have met the threshold,” Utah GOP Chair Rob Axson said Sunday.
